name: OMathBreak
description: Represents individual line breaks in an equation. Each OMathBreak object is a member of the OMathBreaks collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathBreak object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained in the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AlignAt
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the operator in one line, to which Microsoft Word aligns consecutive lines in an equation. Read/write.
